name: x-snc-variable-display-component
label: Variable Display Component
description: Display variables associated with records through direct or M2M relationships

variableTable.label: Variable Table
variableTable.description: The table containing the variables to display

relationshipType.label: Relationship Type
relationshipType.description: How variables are related to the record

m2mTable.label: M2M Table
m2mTable.description: The many-to-many relationship table name (required if relationship type is M2M)

m2mSourceField.label: M2M Source Field
m2mSourceField.description: Field in M2M table that references the current record

m2mVariableField.label: M2M Variable Field
m2mVariableField.description: Field in M2M table that references the variable

directAssociationField.label: Direct Association Field
directAssociationField.description: Field name in variable table that references the current record (for direct relationships)

displayFields.label: Display Fields
displayFields.description: Comma-separated list of fields to display (e.g., question_text,value,type)

maxRecords.label: Maximum Records
maxRecords.description: Maximum number of variables to display
